subject: BlueWave: routing/hotkey eviction feedback causing production latency spike
messages:
From: Tim Brooks <tim.brooks@bluewave.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: oncall@bluewave.ai; ops@bluewave.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production spike — 5xxs + 300ms p99 after 08:50 PDT

Stephanie —

We saw a rollup of errors and latency starting ~08:50 PDT across two of our traffic lanes. Error rate jumped from ~0.2% -> 2.8% and p99 for text-generation rose from 240ms -> 1.1s. Throughput for several routes also dropped ~20%. Our logs show frequent KV cache evictions and a lot of requests being rerouted to the slower model variant. Attaching a short metrics snapshot and a CSV with the most frequent hotkeys.

Can you please escalate? This is impacting our live search features for paying customers.

—Tim
VP, Product
BlueWave AI

Attachments: metrics_snapshot_0705.png (image/png), hotkeys_sample.csv (text/csv)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — 5xxs + 300ms p99 after 08:50 PDT

Tim —

Thanks for the quick heads up and the attachments. I routed this to Rishi on infra immediately and looped in Marissa for account communications. We're treating this as P1 because the impact matches a revenue-affecting SLA.

Immediate actions we're taking:
- Rishi will triage routing decisions and KV eviction logs to confirm whether eviction feedback loops are causing HOL blocking.
- Marissa will prepare an account note for the execs and coordinate an update cadence.
- I'll pull an incident brief and request temporary routing fallbacks.

Can you confirm whether you applied any recent traffic steering rules or client-side prefetch settings in the last 6 hours? That will help root cause.

I'll update within 30 minutes.

—Stephanie
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — initial infra triage

Quick triage notes (now):
- Confirmed a surge of hotkey-prefixed requests that exceed our pathing threshold. KV cache miss rate jumped from 6% -> 37% for the affected prefix group.
- Eviction rate on the LRU window spiked due to an unusual concentrated request distribution (heavy tail on ~12 keys). That caused a feedback loop: evicted keys resulted in more remote fills which congested the hot lane, increasing latency and triggering more evictions.
- Some requests were bounced to the slower model variant because our smart-routing policy fell back when latency exceeded SLOs. That amplified p99 and increased token costs.

Short-term mitigations applied (09:38):
- Increased per-deployment KV window from 8k -> 16k for the BlueWave tenant to reduce thrash.
- Temporarily disabled prefetching for that prefix group to stop aggressive fill churn.
- Enabled forced routing to the faster variant for hotkey prefixes for the next 30 minutes to stabilize p99 until we have a safer config.

Status: error rate down to ~0.9%, p99 trending back to ~420ms, throughput recovering slowly. Continuing to monitor.

Attaching logs excerpt to the incident record.

—Rishi
Sr. Infra Engineer

- Commit to a technical RCA in 72 hours + postmortem and a remediation timeline (longer option)

I'll set up a 30-minute bridge with Tim and the oncall engineer in 20 minutes.

Head of Enterprise Sales

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — ops/exec briefing

Executive summary for leadership: 
- Impact: BlueWave experienced an eviction-driven feedback loop on a concentrated hotkey traffic pattern that produced HOL blocking on the hot lane, pushing fallback routing and increasing p99s and 5xxs.
- Root cause (initial): LRU window + aggressive prefetching for a highly skewed key distribution; routing policy fallbacks moved traffic to slower variants and amplified latency.
- Immediate mitigations: expanded KV window, disabled prefetch for the prefix, forced routing to faster variant, and tuned throttles.
- Next steps (72h): 1) formal RCA, 2) add prefix-aware LFU-like eviction option for highly skewed workloads, 3) suggest customer-side rate-smoothing or client SDK backoff patterns, 4) add better autoscale signals for hot lanes.

Asks for execs: approve a transient 10% credit for the hour of peak impact OR approve a 30% service credit (if customer pushes for compensation due to SLA clause) — preference to start with the smaller credit to preserve relationship.

I'll join the bridge and walk the customer through mitigations.

—Laura
Director, Customer Ops

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Tim Brooks <tim.brooks@bluewave.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 17:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production spike — post-mitigation update and next steps

Tim —

Thanks again for the patience on the call. Short summary: our infra team identified an eviction-feedback loop triggered by a concentrated hotkey distribution plus prefetch behavior. Immediate mitigations (expanded cache window, disabled prefetch for the prefix, forced routing to the faster model variant) brought error rate and p99 back toward baseline. We've left temporary safeguards in place while we complete the RCA.

What you can expect next:
- Incident postmortem and technical RCA in 72 hours.
- We will propose a config change for your tenant: prefix-aware eviction policy (LFU-ish) and a recommended client-side debounce for hotkey queries.
- Marissa will follow up on the credit; we propose a 10% credit for the hour of peak impact, subject to your acceptance.

If you want the ops team to run a short traffic replay to validate the config change before we apply it to prod, we can schedule that this week.

Best,
—Stephanie
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
